review:
The 2018 re-release of BGaming's Zeus slot – better visuals, same 25-line game. The wild pays on its own, and three, four or five of them multiply a win by 7x, 77x or 777x.

Bonus symbols on the first and last reels trigger 10 free spins where reels 1 and 5 lock as wilds and only the middle three spin – so most bonus spins pay something. Medium-high volatility, 8,888x max, 96.29% RTP, free spins about once every 112 spins.
pros: Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 112 spins on average)
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
